basic_details.short_information: The Industrial Research & Development Unit at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has notified 1 vacancy for the Jr. Research Fellow post on a project-based, contractual basis. The engagement carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000 p.m. plus HRA @27%, renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project. Candidates applying for the post must possess B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc.+M.Sc. with 75% or 7.5 CGPA or above and GATE qualified in EE, CS, Maths or Physics without M.Tech, or M.Tech with CGPA 7.5 or above. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in).
Fill out the form completely with educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division details, and work experience.
Send the completed application form along with required documents by email to Prof. Aditya Nema at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the email subject line mentions advertisement No. IITD/IRD/279/2026.
Submit the application by 26/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

Anusandhan National Research Foundation, Science and Engineering Research Board

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Jr. Research Fellow post must meet the following qualification requirements: Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc.+M.Sc. with 75% or 7.5 CGPA or above and GATE qualified in EE, CS, Maths or Physics without M.Tech; or M.Tech with CGPA 7.5 or above. Desirable Qualification: Expertise in one of quantum information theory, quantum error correction or classical information theory is strongly desired. Relaxation: The requirement of NET/GATE examination for the selection to the post of JRF/SRF may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks). 50% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is on a contractual basis with a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA @27%. The appointment is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualifications and requirements. Short-listed candidates will be informed for an online interview. Only short-listed candidates will be notified with online interview details.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Jr. Research Fellow post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project (which is up to 07.07.2029), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the position carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for a relaxation in marks or NET/GATE requirements?
faq.answer: A 50% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. Additionally, the requirement of NET/GATE examination may be relaxed for candidates who graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be notified of the interview?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates satisfying the project post requirements will be informed for an online interview, and interview details will be displayed on the web link http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

faq.question: Q5. What should be mentioned in the email subject line when applying?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their completed application form to Prof. Aditya Nema at [email protected] with advertisement No. IITD/IRD/279/2026 on the subject line.
